meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把消息渠道(如 Slack、Telegram)连接到代理组,管理隔离级别、新增渠道组、查看当前接线,并支持调整渠道与代理组的映射关系。
howto.when: 在添加渠道之后、设置期间,或单独运行以重新配置现有接线时。

say.text: 把 Slack 频道接到 agent group 里。
看看现在有哪些渠道和代理组,接线情况如何?
再添加一个 Telegram 群组,接到现有的 agent group。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you connect messaging channels (e.g., Slack, Telegram) to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups, view current wiring, and adjust channel-to-agent-group mappings.
howto.when_en: After adding a channel, during initial setup, or when running standalone to reconfigure existing channel-to-agent-group wirings.

say_en.text: Connect a Slack channel to an agent group.
Show current channels and agent groups, and how they are wired.
Add a Telegram group and wire it to an existing agent group.
